t: Real Research Today: Drone Art Biennales
title: Real Research Today: Drone Art Biennales
definition: Today's documented research behind Drone Art Biennales.
description:
The road to Drone Art Biennales is already being paved. The Fashion for Good museum and Global Fashion Agenda push circular fashion. 3D-printed fashion (Iris van Herpen) moves from runway to research labs.

Algae-based textiles and dyes cut fashion's water and chemical footprint. Together these programs form the art drones foundation that Drone Art Biennales will build on — the biennale logistics results, the night skies methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as biennale logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Readiness Estimator: Drone Art Biennales
definition: Estimates Drone Art Biennales readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Drone Art Biennales components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a biennale hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Drone Art Biennales Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Drone Art Biennales: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Drone Art Biennales — biennales of drone-based art.

Phase 1 — Prove (art drones): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (biennale logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (night skies): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (curation): biennale hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and art-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
